subject: Further Mathematics

questions.q: Which of the following limits represents the correct definition for the derivative of a function $f(x)$ from first principles?
questions.explain: The standard definition for the derivative of $f(x)$ from first principles represents the limit of the secant slope as the interval approaches 0, which is exactly $\lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}$.
